fair_value_reason: NTM EPS at Oct 2027 (Q4'27-Q3'28) of ~$4.4 (~$2.9-3.0B revenue, ~31.5% non-GAAP GM, ~$390-400M non-GAAP opex, 15% tax, ~98M diluted shares, ~7% execution haircut) at ~20x. That is the 21.5x core CY27 median less modest compression: no extra structural discount is applied because the haircut already carries execution risk. ~$88, plus ~$2.5/share net cash, gives ~$90.5; rounded up for the 1.6T order book to ~$92. Cross-check: NTM EBITDA ~$0.62B x 14x + $0.25B net cash over 98M = ~$91. The agents' revised values are $79-93 (mean $88.4). I sit at the top of that range because agent_1's DCF leg ($58) and the haircut-plus-discount stacking in agents 3-5 partly double-count the same risks. Down from my round-1 $97 because I drop the bull-case weight from the point estimate.

thesis_triggers.event: Below ~$60 (~$5.9B market cap on ~98M diluted shares, ~13x the $4.60 FY27 consensus, under the CY27 multiple of every core peer except the Chinese leaders on S&P data), the market would be pricing FY27 EPS near $2-2.5. That would mean the Q4 step fails (Q4 datacenter revenue needs to roughly double q/q), a top-3 customer (92% of revenue) cuts, or GM stays below 30% with $1B+ of capex unrecovered. It sits ~35% below the September low ($93.62), so ordinary volatility is unlikely to reach it without a fundamental break. The agents' $55-62 bracket it.

supervisor_summary: The revised forecasts converge at fair values of $79-93 (mean $88.4) and P(>=$116) of 0.39-0.44. That convergence comes from the round-1 corrections all agents adopted (tax add-back, $4.60 consensus, ~98M shares, ~$0.25B net cash), so it is shared-source agreement rather than five independent confirmations. The 1-month ladders are near-copies. Four agents correctly overturned my round-1 claim that Innolight/Eoptolink's 15.75x/18.65x are CY27 (they are 12.2x/10.9x on the source's CY27 EPS), but the core-peer CY27 median stays at 21.5x either way. AAOI at 25.1x CY27 is a ~17% premium to that median, which low margins, 92% concentration and equity-funded capex do not justify. I keep the agents' mean ladder, put fair value at ~$92 and the thesis break at $60. The ~Nov 5 Q4 guide, which needs datacenter revenue to roughly double q/q, is the decisive test.
key_drivers: Q4 2026 guide (~Nov 5): ~$1.1B FY26 needs ~$485M in Q4; with Q3 CATV guided at $100-110M, datacenter revenue must go from ~$165M (Q3 midpoint) to ~$370-390M.
Margins: Q2 non-GAAP GM 29.8%, Adjusted EBITDA -$0.5M (Q1 +$1.0M); Q2's $0.06 non-GAAP EPS rests on a $14.3M tax add-back. The $4.60 FY27 consensus needs ~33% GM and real operating leverage.

Valuation: $115.59 is 25.1x the $4.60 CY27 consensus against a 21.5x core-peer CY27 median (Innolight 12.2x, Eoptolink 10.9x, CLS 19.9x, FN 23.2x, COHR 28.7x, LITE 38.4x), a ~17% premium that low GM, 92% top-3 concentration and equity-funded capex do not justify.
Funding and dilution: H1 capex plus prepayments ~$625M against -$74M operating cash flow; $600M ATM live; diluted shares heading to ~98M by the horizon.
Capacity: ~200k units/month (Q2) to >650k by YE2026 and 930k by end-2027 (over half in Texas), with >$200M of 1.6T orders.
